question: How is the goddess bound in love and adornment to the matted-hair lord Śiva?
premises: The goddess is the love-creeper of the matted-hair lord.
The goddess is endowed with a garland of matted hair.
inference: Therefore the goddess is intimately united with Śiva through love and shared ascetic adornment.
plain_english: She is the love-creeper of the matted-hair lord and is adorned with a garland of matted hair.
